# 2025-09-26: Sunsetting of ASTR Vaults and yayASTR/ASTR LP

We sincerely thank all users who participated in ASTR staking through Yay!. Your support across both Sake (v1) and Neemo (v2) vaults, as well as the yayASTR/ASTR LP, has been greatly appreciated.

Starting from **October 1, 2025**, all *Yay! Gold* and *???? Points* distribution for ASTR-related products will end.

This includes:

* **WASTR Vault** (Sake v1)
* **vASTR Vault** (Sake v1)
* **yayASTR Vault** (Neemo v2)
* **yayASTR/ASTR LP**

### **Key Details**

* **No further points will be distributed** to these vaults or LP after *October 1, 2025*.
* **All users with remaining assets in these vaults or LP should withdraw their assets as soon as possible.**

#### **LP Access Still Available on Velodrome**

Although the yayASTR/ASTR LP UI will be removed from the Yay! Dashboard in early October, you can still manage your LP directly on Velodrome:

* [**LP**](https://velodrome.finance/deposit?token0=0x19a80f5dfe30bdf19054716e221539fc040f3b72\&token1=0x2cae934a1e84f693fbb78ca5ed3b0a6893259441\&type=1\&chain=1868\&factory=0x04625B046C69577EfC40e6c0Bb83CDBAfab5a55F\&chain0=1868\&chain1=1868)
* [**Swap yayASTR/ASTR**](https://velodrome.finance/swap?from=0x2cae934a1e84f693fbb78ca5ed3b0a6893259441\&to=0x19a80f5dfe30bdf19054716e221539fc040f3b72\&chain0=1868\&chain1=1868)

#### **ASTR Vault Visibility**

The ASTR vaults will remain visible on the Yay! Dashboard **only for users who still have staked assets**.\
These vaults will show a sunset notice and remain available for withdrawals.\
We will maintain them for a certain period of time and remove them in the future.

For more information on the **Neemo incident** and reimbursement process, please refer to: [Neemo Post-Mortem & Reimbursement Plan](https://yay.gitbook.io/yay-staking/updates/2025-08-27-neemo-finance-incident-post-mortem-and-reimbursement-plan)

If you need assistance with unstaking or withdrawing your assets, please contact us via: [Support Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfjwm3vXTG9ELgVJ-j0fVgJZ2-R8h9fg-kv6qnIqVL_rw7CrA/viewform)
